name: Multi Currency Switcher
author: Saad Iqbal

sections.description:
Currency Switcher for WooCommerce is a multi-currency plugin that lets shoppers browse your store in the currency they trust, without you touching a single product price. Add multiple currencies to any WooCommerce store, format them with symbols, currency codes, or country flags, and drop a currency switcher widget anywhere on your site — the shop page, product pages, cart, checkout, sidebar, or inside a post.

If you’re searching for a WooCommerce currency converter, a multi currency switcher plugin, or a simple way to sell internationally without building a second store per region, this free plugin gets a working currency switcher live in minutes.

🔍 Live Demo | 📄 Documentation | ⭐ Get Pro

Why Store Owners Choose This Currency Switcher

  • Sell globally from one store. No duplicate sites, no separate checkout per region — one WooCommerce install, unlimited currencies.
  • Prices customers actually recognize. Currency symbols, ISO codes, and country flags, formatted the way local shoppers expect.
  • Fewer abandoned carts. Unfamiliar pricing is a well-documented reason shoppers leave at checkout; showing a local currency builds trust and confidence to complete the purchase.
  • Drop it in anywhere. Shortcode or widget support means the currency switcher works on the shop page, product pages, checkout, sidebars, or any post or custom page.
  • Looks like it belongs on your store. Customization options let you match the switcher’s appearance to your store’s design instead of a bolted-on plugin look.
  • Built for mobile shoppers. Fully responsive, so currency switching works cleanly on any device.

Key Features (Free Version)

  • Multi-Currency Support — Display multiple currencies and let shoppers switch between them based on their location or preference, across the entire store.
  • Customized Currency Format — Show currencies using symbols, currency codes, or country flags, formatted to match how local customers expect to see pricing.
  • Flexible Placement — Add the currency switcher to product pages, the shop, cart, checkout, sidebars, or any page or post — it isn’t locked to one location.
  • Widget Customization Options — Adjust the appearance of the currency switcher widget to fit your store’s branding.
  • Simple, Engaging Interface — A clean, user-friendly currency display that doesn’t add friction to the shopping experience.
  • Mobile Optimized — Fully responsive currency switching for shoppers on phones and tablets.

Full Feature List

  • Add multiple currencies to any WooCommerce store
  • Display currency symbols, ISO codes, or country flags
  • Currency switcher widget for sidebars and widget areas
  • Shortcode support to place the switcher on any page, post, or custom template
  • Works on shop, product, cart, and checkout pages
  • Customizable widget styling to match your store’s design
  • Mobile-responsive currency switcher
  • Simple setup with no coding required

Who Is This Currency Switcher For?

  • Stores selling to international customers who see prices in USD, EUR, GBP, or another currency they don’t use day to day
  • Dropshipping and global ecommerce brands expanding into new regions without launching new sites
  • Digital product and subscription stores serving customers across multiple countries
  • Any WooCommerce store that wants to reduce cart abandonment caused by unfamiliar pricing

Upgrade to Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Pro

The free version gets a working multi-currency switcher live on your store. Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Pro turns that into a fully automated, location-aware pricing engine — built for stores that want exchange rates, country-specific pricing, and placement handled for them.

Flagship Pro features:

  • Geo-Location Auto-Detect — Automatically detects a visitor’s country by IP address and displays prices in their home currency the moment they land on your store.
  • Live Exchange Rate API — Auto-update exchange rates hourly, daily, weekly, or on a custom schedule, instead of updating rates by hand.
  • Price by Country — Detects a customer’s country and adjusts not just the currency, but shipping costs, taxes, and discounts to match.
  • Multi-Zone Pricing — Create and manage multiple pricing zones for simple and variable products, with custom rates for specific regions.
  • 4 Currency Switcher Styles — Choose from four built-in styling options so the switcher matches your store’s design out of the box.
  • Flexible Placement Controls — Show the switcher via shortcode, sidebar widget, or on any post, page, or custom post type.
  • Currency by Language — Display currencies based on the store’s active language for multilingual sites.
  • Country Flags as Currency Symbols — Show flags instead of (or alongside) currency codes for instantly recognizable pricing.
  • Multi-Currency Checkout Toggle — Turn multi-currency checkout on or off depending on how you want orders processed.
  • Built-In B2B Compatibility — Works alongside Wholesale for WooCommerce and Donation for WooCommerce for stores running multiple WPExperts extensions together.

See the full Pro feature comparison and upgrade →

Compatibility

Currency Switcher for WooCommerce works alongside the WooCommerce features and extensions you already use, including standard WooCommerce product types, widgets, and shortcodes. Pro adds deeper compatibility with Wholesale for WooCommerce and Donation for WooCommerce for stores combining B2B, donation, and multi-currency functionality.
sections.installation:
1. Go to Plugins > Add New in your WordPress admin.
  2. Search for “Currency Switcher for WooCommerce”.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.
  4. Go to the plugin’s settings to add currencies, choose your currency format (symbol, code, or flag), and set up the switcher widget or shortcode.
  5. Place the switcher on your shop page, product pages, checkout, or sidebar.

Requirements

  • WooCommerce 4.0+
  • WordPress 5.6+
  • PHP 7.4+
sections.faq:
What does Currency Switcher for WooCommerce do?

It’s a multi-currency plugin that lets WooCommerce shoppers view and switch between currencies on your store, using custom symbols, currency codes, or country flags, without you manually converting product prices.

Can I add the currency switcher to my checkout page?

Yes. The switcher isn’t limited to one spot — you can place it on the shop page, product pages, cart, checkout, sidebar widget areas, or any page or post using the shortcode.

Does the free version auto-detect a customer’s country and currency?

Automatic IP-based geolocation and auto-detected currency display are available in Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Pro. The free version lets shoppers choose their currency manually from the switcher.

Does this plugin update exchange rates automatically?

Automatic, scheduled exchange rate updates (hourly, daily, or weekly) are a Pro feature. In the free version, currency rates and formatting are configured directly in the plugin settings.

Can I show country flags instead of currency codes?

Yes, the free version supports currency symbols, currency codes, and flags. Pro adds the option to use flags as the primary currency symbol throughout the store.

Does this work with the latest WordPress and WooCommerce?

Yes. Tested up to WordPress 6.8.6 and current WooCommerce releases.

Can I upgrade from the free version to Pro without losing my settings?

Yes. Your currency and formatting settings carry over when you upgrade to Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Pro.

Is this plugin mobile friendly?

Yes. The currency switcher is fully responsive and works on phones and tablets out of the box.

What’s the difference between this free plugin and Currency Switcher for WooCommerce Pro?

The free version covers core multi-currency display, formatting, and flexible widget/shortcode placement. Pro adds automatic IP geolocation, live exchange rate updates, country-based pricing (including shipping and tax adjustments), multi-zone pricing, four switcher styles, currency-by-language, and built-in compatibility with WPExperts’ B2B and donation plugins. See the Pro feature comparison for full details.

I need help. Where can I get support?

Post your question in the support forum and our team will get back to you. Pro customers get priority support directly from WPExperts.
